Since the beginning of his career, Nicolas Cage had a strict rule: never to do TV. He feared being tied to the same character, the same place, and the same coworkers for years. ⁣
⁣
But after filming 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐫-𝐍𝐨𝐢𝐫 (𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔), Cage said he enjoyed the experience so much that he plans to focus more on similar projects than movies going forward. And after watching all eight episodes for the first time, he described it as one of the happiest and most fulfilling moments of his life, saying the show perfectly combined his two greatest passions: classic cinema and comics.

How do you rate this show out of ten? 👀
